'''Children of the Galaxy''' was an exhibit, held at one point during the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], at the [[Cambriele Exploration Auditorium]] in [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] [[Kikow]] and [[Vareesa Enan]] were known to visit it.
